description: "English Illustration 'The Sixties': 1855-70" by Gleeson White is a collection of critical essays and analyses written in the late 19th century. The work primarily focuses on the art and significance of various illustrators and illustrated periodicals from the 1860s, assessing their contributions to English literature and visual culture during this time.
